content.text:
Not supported by the data: observed lost rentals can't be measured. The dataset has completed trips only, not demand. It also has no history of station status, only one GBFS snapshot at a single instant. So I can't tell how many rentals were lost at JC115 on 2026-10-05 because the station had no bikes.

Lost rentals exist only in the simulation, which is a simulated one-day policy comparison and not a record of that date. I can pull the simulated lost rentals for JC115, or the observed completed trips for that day, if you want either.
